name: 이끼거북
appearance: Broad ancient tortoise with a dark stone shell covered in asymmetrical moss tufts and a tiny fern, grounded squat silhouette.

motions.stand: Facing left, slowly extend and retract the wrinkled neck as the eyes blink, flex the front toes and let the small fern leaf nod once. Heavy stone shell remains still, finish in the original alert stance.
motions.move: Slow deliberate quadruped walk in place toward left, alternate diagonal pairs of short thick legs with visible foot lifts and planting. Neck reaches forward with each step, massive mossy shell rocks minimally, seamless walk loop.
motions.attack1: Facing left, lower the head and draw it inside the shell, brace four feet, then extend the neck in one sharp low headbutt to the left, stop at clear contact, withdraw and return to the alert pose. Keep shell shape intact.
motions.hit1: Facing left, flinch the head inward and bend the front legs under the heavy shell, blink tightly, then extend the head and recover the planted stance.
motions.die1: Facing left, head and front legs slump, remaining legs fold under the shell and the shell settles low on the ground, eyes close. Finish an intact motionless tortoise with neck lying low, no fade or revival.
